evidence: E0020 tested the missing_duration_category operator on seed 0 and scored 0.5989, which is slightly below the baseline. Given the known initialization variance observed in previous Phase 3 multi-seed tests, it is standard to evaluate operators across multiple seeds.
expected_effect: Evaluate whether separating zero/missing duration rows from valid observed durations improves ranking performance consistently, mitigating the impact of seed variance on the evaluation of this data cleaning operator.
hypothesis: Replicating the missing_duration_category operator on seed 1 will confirm if the negative result on seed 0 was merely due to initialization noise, given that over 24,000 training rows contain zero duration.
